# R package pickmdl3

| [Her kjeme noko om CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=GaussSuppression) |  | [pkgdown website](https://statisticsnorway.github.io/ssb-pickmdl3/) |  | [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/statisticsnorway/ssb-pickmdl3) |
|----|----|----|----|----|

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## R package implementing the X-12-ARIMA pickmdl procedure within rjd3

This package makes the pickdml model selection procedure in X-12-ARIMA
available for seasonal adjustment with rjd3. The package relies on
[rjd3toolkit](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=rjd3toolkit) and
[rjd3x13](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=rjd3x13), and enables the
x13 function in rjd3x13 to be run with the pickmdl specification as an
alternative to the default automodel specification. The pickmdl
selection procedure differs from the default automodel procedure, in
that the choiche of seasonal RegARIMA model is restricted to an ordered
set of five parsimonius models. In the case when none of these are
adeaquate, the package provides the option to fall back on the
automdodel procedure. The package further includes functionality for
seasonal adjustment of multiple series based on a data frame with model
specifications.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

📌 See the [broader list of available
functions](https://statisticsnorway.github.io/ssb-pickmdl3/reference/index.html).

------------------------------------------------------------------------

See the package vignettes: [Magnitude table
suppression](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/GaussSuppression/vignettes/Magnitude_table_suppression.html),
[Small count frequency table
suppression](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/GaussSuppression/vignettes/Small_count_frequency_table_suppression.html),
[Defining tables for
GaussSuppression](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/GaussSuppression/vignettes/define_tables.html).

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Installation

Since *pickmdl3* depends on *rjd3toolkit* and *rjd3x13*, refer to the
installation instruction found on the  
[rjdverse](https://github.com/rjdverse) GitHub page. See also the
chapter on R packages in the [Jdemetra+
documentation](https://doc.jdemetra.org/t-r-packages).

Usual installation from GitHub:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("statisticsnorway/ssb-pickmdl3")
```

If you know that the dependencies listed under *Imports* and *Depends*
in the [DESCRIPTION
file](https://github.com/statisticsnorway/ssb-pickmdl/blob/main/DESCRIPTION)
are already installed, an alternative is:

``` r

devtools::install_github("statisticsnorway/pickmdl3", dependencies = FALSE)
```

-

# Package index

## All functions

- [`add_constraint()`](https://statisticsnorway.github.io/ssb-pickmdl3/reference/add_constraint.md)
  : Add a constraint to a constraint data frame object and open for
  editing.

- [`arima_mu()`](https://statisticsnorway.github.io/ssb-pickmdl3/reference/arima_mu.md)
  : Capture whether there is a mean coefficient from x13 output

- [`corona_outliers()`](https://statisticsnorway.github.io/ssb-pickmdl3/reference/corona_outliers.md)
  [`update_spec_corona_outliers()`](https://statisticsnorway.github.io/ssb-pickmdl3/reference/corona_outliers.md)
  : Corona outliers

- [`crit_ok()`](https://statisticsnorway.github.io/ssb-pickmdl3/reference/crit_ok.md)
  : PICKMDL "first" check

- [`crit_selection()`](https://statisticsnorway.github.io/ssb-pickmdl3/reference/crit_selection.md)
  : Selection from table of PICKMDL criteria

- [`crit_table()`](https://statisticsnorway.github.io/ssb-pickmdl3/reference/crit_table.md)
  [`crit123_m_aic()`](https://statisticsnorway.github.io/ssb-pickmdl3/reference/crit_table.md)
  [`crit1()`](https://statisticsnorway.github.io/ssb-pickmdl3/reference/crit_table.md)
  [`crit2()`](https://statisticsnorway.github.io/ssb-pickmdl3/reference/crit_table.md)
  [`crit3()`](https://statisticsnorway.github.io/ssb-pickmdl3/reference/crit_table.md)
  [`m_aic()`](https://statisticsnorway.github.io/ssb-pickmdl3/reference/crit_table.md)
  : Table of PICKMDL criteria

- [`data_edit_ssb()`](https://statisticsnorway.github.io/ssb-pickmdl3/reference/data_edit_ssb.md)
  : An interactive editor for viewing, entering and editing data

- [`edit_constraints()`](https://statisticsnorway.github.io/ssb-pickmdl3/reference/edit_constraints.md)
  : Edit a constraint data frame object

- [`filter_input()`](https://statisticsnorway.github.io/ssb-pickmdl3/reference/filter_input.md)
  : x13 output filters to x13 input filters

- [`make_paramfile()`](https://statisticsnorway.github.io/ssb-pickmdl3/reference/make_paramfile.md)
  : Create an initial parameter file for x13_text_frame(). All values in
  the column are the same

- [`ok()`](https://statisticsnorway.github.io/ssb-pickmdl3/reference/ok.md)
  : PICKMDL information as a list

- [`pickmdl_data()`](https://statisticsnorway.github.io/ssb-pickmdl3/reference/pickmdl_data.md)
  : Function that returns an r object with data

- [`read_yaml_constraints()`](https://statisticsnorway.github.io/ssb-pickmdl3/reference/read_yaml_constraints.md)
  : Read in yaml file with constraints information

- [`text_frame_apply()`](https://statisticsnorway.github.io/ssb-pickmdl3/reference/text_frame_apply.md)
  : Apply function(s) with input from a data frame

- [`update_spec_outliers()`](https://statisticsnorway.github.io/ssb-pickmdl3/reference/update_spec_outliers.md)
  [`update_outliers()`](https://statisticsnorway.github.io/ssb-pickmdl3/reference/update_spec_outliers.md)
  : Update x13 spec with outliers

- [`write_yaml_constraints()`](https://statisticsnorway.github.io/ssb-pickmdl3/reference/write_yaml_constraints.md)
  : Write constraints data.frame object to disk as a yaml file

- [`x13_both()`](https://statisticsnorway.github.io/ssb-pickmdl3/reference/x13_both.md)
  :

  [`x13_spec`](https://rjdverse.github.io/rjd3x13/reference/x13_spec.html)
  and `x13_pickmdl` wrapped as a single function

- [`x13_multi()`](https://statisticsnorway.github.io/ssb-pickmdl3/reference/x13_multi.md)
  : Multiple x13 runs from multiple specifications

- [`x13_pickmdl()`](https://statisticsnorway.github.io/ssb-pickmdl3/reference/x13_pickmdl.md)
  [`x13_automdl()`](https://statisticsnorway.github.io/ssb-pickmdl3/reference/x13_pickmdl.md)
  : x13 with PICKMDL and partial concurrent possibilities

- [`x13_spec_pickmdl()`](https://statisticsnorway.github.io/ssb-pickmdl3/reference/x13_spec_pickmdl.md)
  : Multiple X-13ARIMA model specifications

- [`x13_text_frame()`](https://statisticsnorway.github.io/ssb-pickmdl3/reference/x13_text_frame.md)
  :

  Multiple `x13_both` runs with code input from a data frame
